To fight, struggle, contend with, wage war; योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं
 य एतेऽत्र समागताः
To conquer or overcome in fight. ━Caus. (योधयति-ते)

To oppose or encounter in fight with; सा बाणवर्षिणं रामं योधयित्वा
 सुरद्विषाम्

To vanquish, conquer. ━Desid. (युयुत्सते) To wish to fight.
━With {@नि@} to wrestle, box. ━{@प्रति@} to encounter in fight, oppose.
War, battle, fight, contest; निघातयिष्यन् युधि यातुधानान्

N. of a king of the Kekayas and maternal uncle of
 Bharata; मातुलस्य नगरे युधाजितः प्रेषितौ भरतलक्ष्मणानुजौ Rāmāyaṇachampū.
A warrior, a man of the warrior caste.

‘Firm in battle’, N. of the eldest Pāṇḍava prince,
 also called ‘Dharma’, ‘Dharmarāja’, ‘Ajātaśatru’ &c. [He was begotten
 on Kuntī by the god Yama. He is known more for his truthfulness and righteousness
 than for any military achievements or feats of arms. He was formally crowned
 emperor of Hastināpura at the conclusion of the great Bhāratī war after
 eighteen daysʼ severe fighting, and reigned righteously for many years.
 For further particulars about his life, see दुर्योधन.]
